final_message:
I rewrote the skill's description, which is the only part agents see before deciding to load it. I haven't run the test with the fix in place yet, so I can't say it works.

**The cause.** The skill listing showed only `description: Helps with parquet files.` That line doesn't say when the skill applies. It also contains none of the words an agent has in mind when it's about to write a file, so nothing matched. The rest of the skill was fine.

**The change**, in `skills/parquet-schema-check/SKILL.md:3`:

```yaml
description: Use when writing, saving or exporting a DataFrame to a Parquet file (to_parquet, write_parquet, pyarrow.parquet.write_table), or when a job fails reading a Parquet file on a schema, column or dtype mismatch.
```

- It covers the moment that matters (just before the write) and the symptom later (a failed read).
- It names the actual write calls in pandas, polars and pyarrow, since those are the words that will be in front of the agent.
- It doesn't summarise the steps. Agents that see a summary tend to follow it and skip the full skill. That matters here because the important rule is in step 3: "stop and report, do not cast to make them match."
- It's about 207 characters, well under the 1024 limit. Codex has recently cut descriptions longer than about 160 characters when it lists many skills. If that happens, the first clause and the call names come first and should survive.

**Still to do:**
1. **Run the same baseline scenarios again with this description** and check that agents now load the skill before the write, and that they stop instead of casting. I can't start subagents with the tools I have this turn, so I need you to run them or let me. If they still miss it, the next thing to check is whether Claude Code is dropping the description because the listing is full. `/skill-doctor` or the Skills row of `/context` will show that.
2. **There's no `license` field in the frontmatter.** It's required in this setup, but the repo has no LICENSE file and `polars-lazy-tuning` doesn't set one either, so I didn't guess a value. Tell me which licence to use and I'll add it to both skills.
3. **Not committed.** I can't run git this turn, so I'll commit once the retest passes.
